title: Oxidation-Free Heat Treatment of SLM Ti-6Al-4V: Microstructure Control
content: SLM Ti-6Al-4V specimens were heat-treated in a conventional furnace using a closed austenitic foil enclosure with continuous argon supply. Four schedules were studied: 620 °C/2 h, 950 °C/2 h, 950 °C/6 h, and 1040 °C/30 min followed by 750 °C/2 h. OM and SEM showed retained acicular mor-phology after stress relief, lamellar α + β features after the 950 °C treatments (coarser after 6 h), and coarse Widmanstätten-type morphology after the two-step cycle. EDS map-sum spectra gave sim-ilar area-averaged values (89.9–90.2 wt.% Ti, 5.6–6.1 wt.% Al, 3.9–4.2 wt.% V) but did not resolve phase-specific composition or oxygen uptake. A supplementary HV1 comparison gave mean hardness values of 387.5 ± 6.3 for as-built and 351.5 ± 4.2 for heat-treated specimens (n = 8 indenta-tions per condition). No pronounced continuous altered band was observed in the examined cross-sections; this does not establish zero oxygen uptake.
